events.problem_statement: Idle protocol needs a bounded hard stop when consensus does not form.

simulation_evidence.summary: Ten rounds without matching consensus markers should hard converge.

events.problem_statement: Idle protocol needs a bounded hard stop when consensus does not form.
events.alternative_proposal: Use a lower round limit and require earlier operator review.

When operator review happens earlier, fewer ungrounded rounds accumulate.
If consensus is weak, finalists provide safer evidence than auto execution.
events.tradeoff_axis: Shorter deliberation versus more peer exploration.
